item.title: Indian citizen extradited to Nassau pleads guilty to manslaughter stemming from 2005 Hicksville crash
item.description: An Indian citizen, who was extradited to Nassau County in September 2025 to face indictment charges for a high-speed crash on Old Country Road in Hicksville in April 2005 that killed a 44-year-old father and husband, pleaded guilty on Friday, Feb. 6, Nassau County District Attorney Anne Donnelly announced.
